title: Concept: Source archive published under the web root
description: An archive of the application source reachable from the host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A source archive gives an attacker the whole code base, including comments, keys and the route list, without needing a single injection.
applicability: Deployments that render an archive of the application source reachable from the host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A source archive gives an attacker the whole code base, including comments, keys and the route list, without needing a single injection.
